clips.title: The story
paras: Talondeep Vale is a quiet, forested hollow nestled in south-central Ashenvale. Bordering Silverwind Refuge, the Ruins of Stardust, and the gateway to the Stonetalon Mountains, it acts as a peaceful canopy through which travelers navigate southern Kalimdor.

Tucked away beneath the dense canopy of south-central Ashenvale, Talondeep Vale serves as a crossroads between several landmark sites. It is framed by Silverwind Refuge to the east, the haunting Ruins of Stardust nearby, and the rugged rise leading up into the Stonetalon Mountains. Shaded by ancient trees, the valley remains an untamed tract of woodland through which night elf wardens, sentinels, and passing wanderers traverse as they move between the heart of the forest and the high crags beyond.
